# Discord OpenClaw + QMD + Vault Recovery

## Goal
Recover the old Discord/OpenClaw operating pattern — including QMD, vault habits, session memory, graph/query workflows, and agent-readable context — and reconcile it into EMA instead of treating it as a separate dead system.

## Recovery principle
Do **not** restore the old system verbatim.
Recover:
- the strongest mechanisms
- the working conventions
- the operational feel
- the useful memory/query flows

Translate them into EMA-native language and structure.

## What to recover
- Discord as a real command/control and ambient ops surface
- QMD indexing/query habits
- vault-style graph knowledge and dense linking
- session summaries / memory promotion / chronicle habits
- inbox/capture/promote workflows
- maintenance / freshness / health scoring
- ontology-sync / graph extraction ambitions
- human+agent shared context patterns

## What to avoid
- restoring old vocabulary if it narrows EMA incorrectly
- reintroducing fragmented source-of-truth split
- keeping vault/Discord/agent memory as detached subsystems

## Reconciliation target
EMA should absorb these as regions/capabilities of one system:
- Discord operations surface
- QMD/graph/query substrate
- shared memory/chronicle/recall substrate
- capture/promote/maintenance loops
- human+agent workspace conventions

## Immediate deliverables
- legacy system inventory
- mechanism-by-mechanism recovery map
- language translation map
- source-of-truth reconciliation map
- migration / revival sequence
